csv_project_name: CMAR for ExxonMobil Event Center & Sterling Library
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Baytown, Texas, in Graham Associates (GAI) serving as Owner s Representative & Barker Rinker Seacat (BRS) as Architect, is soliciting Statements of Qualifications and Proposals from qualified Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) firms to provide preconstruction and construction services for the ExxonMobil Baytown Events Center (EMBEC) and the renovation of the Sterling Municipal Library (collectively, the Project ). The Project will deliver a new state-of-the-art indoor sports, entertainment, and community events facility integrated with a renovated public library to form a cohesive civic and recreational campus near downtown Baytown and the Lee College campus.
